collection.title: Ford Transit Courier 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Transit Courier 2014 Onwards requires a 28" wiper blade for the drivers side and a 16" blade for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
